name: New Earth Voyagers
source:
The year is 2234, Earth, humanity’s planet of origin, lies in ruin.
Samantha, or Sam as she likes to be called, is your close friend and crew member.
…You both work as voyagers aboard the Weevil Light Cruiser, exploring unknown lands and completing other tasks at the request of Fleet Command.

[From [url=https://hello-its-jack.itch.io/new-earth-voyagers]itch.io[/url]]
